integrity: Analytical proof, explicit original-coordinate integrals and self-contained Python checks supplied; independent scholarly audit and validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem is for surface-area-uniform points on two-dimensional spherical caps embedded in Euclidean 3-space, with ambient Euclidean chord distances.
The sharp 2-sqrt(3) constant is for normalized cutoff-height reconstruction, not the angular inequality; the latter has an optimal exponent but no asserted best constant.
Exact population moments only; no finite-sample estimation, error bars, arbitrary-patch classification, or higher-dimensional result.
Historical priority is provisional; the accessible 2020 forward distribution may support related deductions.
title: Two even Euclidean chord moments identify spherical caps, with optimal inverse exponents
